svg.title: Three atomic paths: flash loop, flash unwind, flash exit
svg.desc: Three numbered routes through the Pylon flash engine on Mezo Testnet: a loop that adds collateral and borrows more, an unwind that repays debt and releases collateral, and an exit that closes the trove. Each route runs inside one transaction authorised by one EIP-712 signature.
svg.text: Loop · Unwind · Exit — one signature, one transaction each

g.text: How a borrower leverages up, unwinds, or exits a Mezo trove in one
transaction — with 0 MUSD in the wallet and only the numbers the user
wants more BTC collateral, without buying it first
wants debt down; keeps the collateral that stays free
wants out — the whole trove unwound in one shot
park P MUSD in the helper

svg.text: EXACTNESS · THE EIP-712 SIGNATURE IS THE SLIPPAGE GUARD
Pylon cannot move more collateral or debt than the user authorised — if the swap cannot deliver the signed collateral, the transaction reverts.

g.text: X / D / P = the signed amounts
